metadata.title: SpaceX share slide continues, and other early market movers - MarketWatch

content.text:
4 hours ago
SpaceX share slide continues, and other early market movers
Here are some of the stocks making notable moves in Tuesday's premarket action:
SpaceX shares are following up Monday's 16.4% dive with a further 2.7% loss as the steam continues to come out of the biggest ever IPO.
Avis Budget shares are up 2% after Pentwater Capital agreed it would pay the car hire group $650 million following the hedge fund's dumping of stock following a short squeeze in April.
Strategy stock is dipping nearly 3% to flirt with fresh 52-week lows as investors continue to show concern about the bitcoin hoarder's funding mechanism.
Shares of Micron Technology are down 8% ahead of earnings on Wednesday, and SanDisk stock is sliding 7.5% as the high-flying memory-chip plays suffer from a dive in South Korean peers SK Hynix and Samsung Electronics.
